name: Punch in

provenance.note: editor grammar (R4 edit styles: 115-140 % punch-ins on word boundaries)

summary: On a word boundary to mark a key word or a new thought; alternate with punch out so a single take feels like two cameras.

data.about: An instant reframe tighter (no visible motion), aimed at a point if given; it holds until the next call. The talking-head editor's basic cut.
data.avoid: Two punches inside one second; punching past ~1.4x on low-resolution footage (it goes soft).
